stem: A teacher first teaches pupils the individual sounds that letters and letter-combinations make, then has them blend these sounds together to decode and read new words, before introducing whole-word recognition. This approach to teaching reading is called the:
explanation: The phonics method teaches letter-sound relationships explicitly, having learners blend sounds to decode new words — contrasted with the Whole Language Approach.
